source: 外研社版必修第一册 Unit 6 同主题完形(沙漠骆驼/自制花草茶/校园屋顶花园/瀑布之行/海底世界/社区绿化)。用词限 U6/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: Camels and Grapes in Turpan
passages.text: Last summer my family travelled to Xinjiang, a place I had always wanted to (1)____. We spent three days in the Turpan (2)____, which is famous for its sweet grapes. The weather was hot and dry, and the land looked like a huge (3)____ of golden sand. One afternoon we rode (4)____, the animals that people call 'the ships of the desert'. Sitting up so high, I felt as if I were going to (5)____ across an ocean of sand. Our guide showed us the special houses (6)____ grapes are dried into raisins. The walls have many small holes that let the wind (7)____ through. In this clever way the grapes lose their water but keep their sweet (8)____. On our last evening, we watched the sun go down over the (9)____, and everything turned a soft gold. I will never (10)____ that wonderful trip.

sail across an ocean of sand 在沙海上航行。
the houses where grapes are dried 地点先行词用 where。
let the wind pass through 让风穿过。
keep their sweet flavour 保持甜味。
the sun went down over the sand 沙漠上。
never forget the trip 永远不会忘记。

passages.title: Tea from Our Own Garden

passages.title: Our School Rooftop Garden
passages.text: Our school had an empty (1)____ that almost no one ever used. Last year our teacher had a clever (2)____: why not turn it into a garden? passages.title: A Walk to the Waterfall
passages.text: On our trip to Guizhou, we walked through a green (1)____ to reach the famous Huangguoshu (2)____. Long before we could see it, we could (3)____ a deep, thundering sound far ahead. passages.title: The World Beneath the Sea

passages.title: Greening Our Neighbourhood
